name: Fitness Tracker
highLevelGoals: The Fitness Enthusiast aims to meticulously track and analyze advanced performance metrics from their physical activities to gain deeper insights into their training and optimize their performance.
The Fitness Enthusiast seeks to set challenging fitness goals and effectively monitor their progress towards achieving and surpassing these targets, driving continuous improvement.
The Fitness Enthusiast desires personalized workout recommendations that adapt to their evolving fitness level and specific goals, ensuring efficient and effective training.
The Beginner User aims to easily record and monitor all their physical activities, both automatically and manually, to establish consistent exercise habits.
The Beginner User seeks clear visual representations of their fitness progress and timely notifications of achievements to maintain motivation and understand their improvements.
The Beginner User wants to set realistic and adjustable fitness goals to provide direction and a sense of accomplishment, fostering a sustainable fitness journey.
The Beginner User desires personalized workout recommendations that guide them through suitable exercises and adapt to their feedback, helping them progress safely and effectively.
The Wearable Device User aims to effortlessly connect their wearable devices to the application to automatically sync and consolidate all their fitness data in one place.
The Wearable Device User seeks to receive real-time and accurate fitness metrics from their wearable device within the application, ensuring up-to-date insights into their performance.
The Social Sharer aims to easily post their completed activities and fitness milestones on social media platforms to celebrate their progress and connect with their network.
The Social Sharer seeks to use social media sharing features to inspire friends and family, receive support, and foster a sense of community around their fitness journey.
lowLevelGoals: The system should allow the Fitness Enthusiast to retrieve and display their heart rate variability (HRV) data for a selected period.
The system should enable the Fitness Enthusiast to view and analyze trends in their training load over time, broken down by intensity and duration.
The system should allow the Fitness Enthusiast to compare their current performance metrics (e.g., pace, power) against their historical bests or averages for similar activities.
The system should allow the Fitness Enthusiast to define a new fitness target, specifying the metric (e.g., 'run 5k in under 20 minutes'), the target value, and the deadline.
The system should display the Fitness Enthusiast's current progress percentage or remaining effort towards a selected fitness goal.
The system should send a notification to the Fitness Enthusiast when they achieve or surpass a set fitness goal.
The system should generate a workout plan for the Fitness Enthusiast based on their specified goals, current fitness level, and preferred activity types.
The system should allow the Fitness Enthusiast to manually adjust the intensity level of their current workout plan.
The system should automatically update and present new workout recommendations to the Fitness Enthusiast based on their completed activities and performance data.
The system should allow the Beginner User to manually input details for a completed activity, including type, duration, distance, and calories burned.
The system should allow the Beginner User to initiate automatic tracking of an activity (e.g., 'Start Run') using device sensors.
The system should display a summary of all activities logged by the Beginner User for the current day, including total duration and calories.
The system should present the Beginner User with a visual graph showing their activity levels and progress over the past week.
The system should award and display virtual badges to the Beginner User upon reaching specific milestones (e.g., 'First 5k', '7 Days Active').
The system should display encouraging messages to the Beginner User based on their recent activity and progress.
The system should allow the Beginner User to set a new, simple fitness goal (e.g., 'Walk 30 minutes daily'), specifying the activity and frequency.
The system should allow the Beginner User to adjust the parameters (e.g., duration, frequency) of an already set fitness goal.
The system should confirm to the Beginner User when they have successfully completed a set fitness goal.
The system should provide the Beginner User with a suggestion for a simple, guided workout based on their initial profile.
The system should prompt the Beginner User to provide feedback on the difficulty and enjoyment of a completed workout.
The system should automatically adjust the intensity or type of the next workout suggestion for the Beginner User based on their previous feedback.
The system should provide an interface for the Wearable Device User to connect a new wearable fitness device (e.g., 'Connect Apple Watch', 'Connect Garmin').
The system should allow the Wearable Device User to manually trigger a data synchronization from their connected wearable device.
The system should show the Wearable Device User the connection status and last sync time for all integrated wearable devices.
The system should display the Wearable Device User's current heart rate in real-time, streamed from their connected wearable device during an active workout.
The system should display the Wearable Device User's live pace or speed during an activity, updated continuously from their wearable device.
The system should display the Wearable Device User's current GPS route on a map in real-time during an outdoor activity.
The system should allow the Social Sharer to select a completed activity and post its summary (e.g., distance, time, map) to a chosen social media platform.
The system should allow the Social Sharer to share a specific fitness milestone (e.g., 'New Personal Best', 'Reached 100km') to a chosen social media platform.
The system should allow the Social Sharer to add custom text and emojis to their social media posts before sharing.
The system should allow the Social Sharer to tag friends or contacts in their fitness-related social media posts.
The system should notify the Social Sharer when their shared fitness posts receive comments or likes on social media.
The system should display a feed of fitness activities and achievements shared by the Social Sharer's connected friends within the application.
